subject: english
stem: This conversation takes place before the first class. What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: asking to keep the science posters after Monday
reporting that the science posters are already missing
asking permission to borrow the science posters
asking permission to borrow the plant trays

optionRationales.reason: asking to keep the science posters after Monday：此項把「permission to borrow the science posters」改成「to keep the science posters after Monday」。整段對話的主要功能為「asking permission to borrow the science posters」。因此，鎖定證據支持「asking permission to borrow the science posters」。

reporting that the science posters are already missing：此項把「asking permission to borrow the science posters」改成「reporting that the science posters are already missing」。整段對話的主要功能為「asking permission to borrow the science posters」。因此，鎖定證據支持「asking permission to borrow the science posters」。
asking permission to borrow the science posters：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「asking permission to borrow the science posters」。
asking permission to borrow the plant trays：此項把「science posters」改成「plant trays」。整段對話的主要功能為「asking permission to borrow the science posters」。因此，鎖定證據支持「asking permission to borrow the science posters」。
